plugin.name: Autobuff_Tracker
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Shows enabled status for Aegis, BuildUp, and Endurance autobuff triggers
plugin.description:
AUTOBUFF TRACKER
Displays the current enabled/disabled state of:
Aegis BuildUp Endurance
Default theme: green = enabled, red = disabled. Amber/Green themes: bright lamp = enabled, dim lamp = disabled. Gray lamp = trigger not found
The lamps are clickable.
Clicking a lamp runs the existing aliases:
Aegis: agon agoff
BuildUp: bon boff
Endurance: endon endoff
Commands:
autobuffs show autobuffs hide
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
Win = GetPluginID()
-------------------------------------------------- -- WINDOW --------------------------------------------------
WINDOW_WIDTH = 205 WINDOW_HEIGHT = 105
TITLE_HEIGHT = 21
ROW_HEIGHT = 27
TITLE_FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" TITLE_FONT_SIZE = 9
BODY_FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" BODY_FONT_SIZE = 10
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHARED UI THEMES --------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "autobuff"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
default = { background = "#000000", border = "#808080", title_bar = "darkslategray", title_text = "gold", label = "#D4D0C8", row_separator = "#282828",
bezel_fill = "#2A2A2A", bezel_border = "#000000",
on_outer = "#0D4D1A", on_middle = "#1F9E3D", on_inner = "#4DFF6E", on_highlight = "#CFFFD9",
off_outer = "#4D0D0D", off_middle = "#9E1F1F", off_inner = "#FF4D4D", off_highlight = "#FFD9D9" },
amber = { background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title_text = "#FFB347", label = "#D9822B", row_separator = "#2D1809",
bezel_fill = "#24160B", bezel_border = "#050301",
on_outer = "#6B3308", on_middle = "#C66A12", on_inner = "#FF9D26", on_highlight = "#FFE0A3",
off_outer = "#201207", off_middle = "#35200D", off_inner = "#4A2A0D", off_highlight = "#69401B" },
green = { background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title_text = "#9AFF82", label = "#67C967", row_separator = "#102A10",
bezel_fill = "#102010", bezel_border = "#000500",
on_outer = "#0D4D1A", on_middle = "#1F9E3D", on_inner = "#4DFF6E", on_highlight = "#CFFFD9",
off_outer = "#061507", off_middle = "#0B2910", off_inner = "#123B17", off_highlight = "#20582A" } }
function LoadTheme()
local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[theme] then theme = "default" end
local T = THEMES[theme]
BACKGROUND_COLOUR = ThemeColour("background", T.background) BORDER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("border", T.border) TITLE_BAR_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar) TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_text", T.title_text) LABEL_COLOUR = ThemeColour("label", T.label) ROW_SEPARATOR_COLOUR = ThemeColour("row_separator", T.row_separator)
BEZEL_FILL = ThemeColour("bezel_fill", T.bezel_fill) BEZEL_BORDER = ThemeColour("bezel_border", T.bezel_border)
ON_OUTER = ThemeColour("on_outer", T.on_outer) ON_MIDDLE = ThemeColour("on_middle", T.on_middle) ON_INNER = ThemeColour("on_inner", T.on_inner) ON_HIGHLIGHT = ThemeColour("on_highlight", T.on_highlight)
OFF_OUTER = ThemeColour("off_outer", T.off_outer) OFF_MIDDLE = ThemeColour("off_middle", T.off_middle) OFF_INNER = ThemeColour("off_inner", T.off_inner) OFF_HIGHLIGHT = ThemeColour("off_highlight", T.off_highlight)
MISSING_OUTER = ColourNameToRGB("#252525") MISSING_MIDDLE = ColourNameToRGB("#555555") MISSING_INNER = ColourNameToRGB("#888888") MISSING_HIGHLIGHT = ColourNameToRGB("#D0D0D0") end
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------- -- AUTOBUFF DEFINITIONS --------------------------------------------------
autobuffs = {
{ name = "Aegis", trigger = "ag",
enableAlias = "agon", disableAlias = "agoff",
hotspot = "autobuff_aegis" },
{ name = "BuildUp", trigger = "b",
enableAlias = "bon", disableAlias = "boff",
hotspot = "autobuff_buildup" },
{ name = "Endurance", trigger = "end",
enableAlias = "endon", disableAlias = "endoff",
hotspot = "autobuff_endurance" }
}
-------------------------------------------------- -- STATE -- -- true = enabled -- false = disabled -- nil = trigger could not be found --------------------------------------------------
buffStates = {}
windowinfo = ""
windowVisible = true
-------------------------------------------------- -- READ GLOBAL/WORLD TRIGGER STATE --------------------------------------------------
function GetWorldTriggerState(triggerName)
-------------------------------------------------- -- Empty plugin ID means global/world triggers. -- -- InfoType 8 = enabled. --------------------------------------------------
local state = GetPluginTriggerInfo( "", triggerName, 8 )
if state == nil then return nil end
if state == true then return true end
if state == false then return false end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Defensive handling in case MUSHclient returns -- a numeric boolean variant. --------------------------------------------------
if state == 1 then return true end
if state == 0 then return false end
return nil
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- READ ALL THREE STATES --------------------------------------------------
function RefreshStates()
local changed = false
for index, buff in ipairs( autobuffs ) do
local newState = GetWorldTriggerState( buff.trigger )
if buffStates[index] ~= newState then
buffStates[index] = newState
changed = true
end
end
return changed
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- GLOSSY LAMP -- -- Adapted from the layered lamp style in the -- Chakra Cooldown plugin. --------------------------------------------------
function DrawLamp( left, top, right, bottom, outerColour, middleColour, innerColour, highlightColour )
local width = right - left
local height = bottom - top
-------------------------------------------------- -- Dark outer layer --------------------------------------------------
WindowCircleOp( Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse,
left, top, right, bottom,
outerColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0,
outerColour, miniwin.brush_solid )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Middle glow --------------------------------------------------
local midInset = width * 0.18
WindowCircleOp( Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse,
left + midInset, top + midInset,
right - midInset, bottom - midInset,
middleColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0,
middleColour, miniwin.brush_solid )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Bright centre --------------------------------------------------
local innerInset = width * 0.38
WindowCircleOp( Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse,
left + innerInset, top + innerInset,
right - innerInset, bottom - innerInset,
innerColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0,
innerColour, miniwin.brush_solid )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Highlight --------------------------------------------------
local highlightDiameter = width * 0.26
local highlightLeft = left + ( width * 0.15 )
local highlightTop = top + ( height * 0.13 )
WindowCircleOp( Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse,
highlightLeft, highlightTop,
highlightLeft + highlightDiameter,
highlightTop + highlightDiameter,
highlightColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0,
highlightColour, miniwin.brush_solid )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DRAW ONE SMALL STATUS LIGHT --------------------------------------------------
function DrawStatusLamp( centreX, centreY, state )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Small enough to work like an instrument-panel LED. --------------------------------------------------
local diameter = 15
local radius = diameter / 2
local left = centreX - radius
local top = centreY - radius
local right = centreX + radius
local bottom = centreY + radius
-------------------------------------------------- -- Bezel --------------------------------------------------
local bezelPad = 3
WindowCircleOp( Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse,
left - bezelPad, top - bezelPad,
right + bezelPad, bottom + bezelPad,
BEZEL_BORDER, miniwin.pen_solid, 1,
BEZEL_FILL, miniwin.brush_solid )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Lamp --------------------------------------------------
if state == true then
DrawLamp( left, top, right, bottom,
ON_OUTER, ON_MIDDLE, ON_INNER, ON_HIGHLIGHT )
elseif state == false then
DrawLamp( left, top, right, bottom,
OFF_OUTER, OFF_MIDDLE, OFF_INNER, OFF_HIGHLIGHT )
else
DrawLamp( left, top, right, bottom,
MISSING_OUTER, MISSING_MIDDLE, MISSING_INNER, MISSING_HIGHLIGHT )
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DRAW WINDOW --------------------------------------------------
function Redraw_Window()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Background --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill,
0, 0,
WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT,
BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Title bar --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill,
0, 0,
WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT,
TITLE_BAR_COLOUR )
WindowLine( Win,
0, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1,
WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1,
BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, "AUTOBUFFS",
8, 3,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 8, TITLE_HEIGHT,
TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR, false )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Rows --------------------------------------------------
for index, buff in ipairs( autobuffs ) do
local rowTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + ( (index - 1) * ROW_HEIGHT )
local rowBottom = rowTop + ROW_HEIGHT
local centreY = rowTop + math.floor( ROW_HEIGHT / 2 )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Label --------------------------------------------------
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, buff.name,
11, rowTop + 6,
145, rowBottom,
LABEL_COLOUR, false )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Status lamp --------------------------------------------------
DrawStatusLamp( 176, centreY, buffStates[ index ] )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Row separator --------------------------------------------------
if index < #autobuffs then
WindowLine( Win,
8, rowBottom - 1,
WINDOW_WIDTH - 8, rowBottom - 1,
ROW_SEPARATOR_COLOUR,
miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Border --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame,
0, 0,
WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT,
BORDER_COLOUR )
Redraw()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- POLLING --------------------------------------------------
function PollAutobuffs()
if RefreshStates() then
Redraw_Window()
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- CLICK HANDLER --------------------------------------------------
function ToggleAutobuff( flags, hotspot_id )
for index, buff in ipairs( autobuffs ) do
if buff.hotspot == hotspot_id then
local state = GetWorldTriggerState( buff.trigger )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Trigger missing. --------------------------------------------------
if state == nil then
ColourNote( "red", "", "Autobuff trigger '" .. buff.trigger .. "' was not found." )
return
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Use the user's EXISTING aliases to make the -- change. --------------------------------------------------
if state then
Execute( buff.disableAlias )
else
Execute( buff.enableAlias )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Existing alias executes first; poll almost -- immediately afterward to update the lamp. --------------------------------------------------
DoAfterSpecial( 0.05, "PollAutobuffs()", sendto.script )
return
end
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- INSTALL HOTSPOTS --------------------------------------------------
function InstallHotspots()
for index, buff in ipairs( autobuffs ) do
local rowTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + ( (index - 1) * ROW_HEIGHT )
local rowBottom = rowTop + ROW_HEIGHT
-------------------------------------------------- -- Whole row is clickable, not merely the tiny lamp. --------------------------------------------------
WindowAddHotspot( Win, buff.hotspot,
0, rowTop,
WINDOW_WIDTH, rowBottom,
"", "", "", "", "ToggleAutobuff",
"Toggle " .. buff.name,
miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- INSTALL --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall()
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Initial placeholder window --------------------------------------------------
check( WindowCreate( Win, 0, 0,
WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT,
0, 0,
BACKGROUND_COLOUR ) )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Fonts --------------------------------------------------
check( WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win,
TITLE_FONT_NAME, TITLE_FONT_SIZE,
true ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "body"..Win,
BODY_FONT_NAME, BODY_FONT_SIZE,
false ) )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Movable window --------------------------------------------------
windowinfo = movewindow.install( Win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true )
check( WindowCreate( Win,
windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top,
WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT,
windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags,
BACKGROUND_COLOUR ) )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Title-bar dragging --------------------------------------------------
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Clickable autobuff rows --------------------------------------------------
InstallHotspots()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Read actual initial states --------------------------------------------------
RefreshStates()
Redraw_Window()
WindowShow( Win, true )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SAVE POSITION --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginSaveState()
movewindow.save_state( Win )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ENABLE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginEnable()
LoadTheme()
RefreshStates()
Redraw_Window()
WindowShow( Win, true )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DISABLE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginDisable()
WindowShow( Win, false )
Redraw()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHOW --------------------------------------------------
function autobuffs_show( name, line, wildcards )
windowVisible = true
RefreshStates()
Redraw_Window()
WindowShow( Win, true )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Autobuff tracker shown." )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- HIDE --------------------------------------------------
function autobuffs_hide( name, line, wildcards )
windowVisible = false
WindowShow( Win, false )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Autobuff tracker hidden." )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEME BROADCAST --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme() Redraw_Window() end
